Video.title: Video
Video.description: A video with an encrypted target link that users can unlock.

thumbnailUrl.description: The image thumbnail for the video

videoUrl.description: The watch URL of the video (e.g., YouTube embed or dummy video)

encryptedTargetLink.description: The target link encrypted using AES

requiredAdsCount.description: Number of ads required to unlock this link (default 3)

views.description: Number of views on this video

UnlockProgress.title: Unlock Progress
UnlockProgress.description: Tracks a user's progress in watching ads to unlock a specific video's link.

userId.description: Telegram user ID or simulated user ID

videoId.description: The ID of the video being unlocked

adsWatched.description: Number of ads watched so far for this video

AdminSettings.title: Admin Settings
AdminSettings.description: Global application settings managed by the administrator.

globalAdCode.description: Global ad injection script or key

encryptionSalt.description: Salt used to encrypt target links on database

videos/{videoId}.description: Collection of YouTube-like videos with target links

unlocks/{unlockId}.description: Collection tracking user ad-watching progress per video
